traceability.notes: Story 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION has been fully implemented. The `valid-annotation-format` ESLint rule and its helpers enforce precise format and syntax rules for `@story`, `@req`, and `@supports` annotations, including default and configurable regex-based specifications. Multiline annotations and flexible whitespace are supported, and detailed, requirement-specific error messages are produced for missing or malformed values. The rule integrates into the plugin's recommended/strict configs and operates on all comments, ensuring compatibility with function and branch annotation rules. Comprehensive unit and performance tests explicitly tied to this story and its requirement IDs are passing, and dedicated documentation under `docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md` describes the format specification, examples, options, and error messages. Therefore all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied.
